about: a file named pdf.pdf whose bytes are not a PDF, so Read PDF fails

reads.note: Read Binary File v1 reads /data/pdf.pdf into binary data; Read PDF v1 extracts its text (pdf.js)

expect.offline: The file is read from the absolute path the template names (/data/pdf.pdf, placed by the fixture; the bench allows its directory). The workflow writes nothing and calls no model, so its only result is Read PDF's text in the last node (README P50: gate 4 reports `nothing compared` for such a run)
